about: The recordings ROVLOC's sounds are made from (docs/SOUND.md 2), unmodified, each from a pack whose page states CC0. packs: "<lib>/<pack>" (kenney = kenney.nl, oga = opengameart.org) -> its page, its author as the page names them (submitter: who uploaded it, when the page names someone else), links: the links its description gives (a work it was derived from, the author's site or game), its licences, the archive(s) the files came out of (name and SHA-256 of the download), and files: name -> SHA-256 and size of the stored file and its path inside the pack (original: the WAV a FLAC was losslessly made from). Written by web/sounds/import.mjs; never edited by hand.
